title: Carve 0.2 Unicode general categories
description: The code points of the general categories that clauses of the 0.2 documents name, for the one Unicode version they pin (C2-I-127). Generated by scripts/spec2-unicode.mjs from UnicodeData.txt; do not edit by hand. Sorted by name.

unicode.description: The Unicode version the ranges are taken from.

source.description: The URL of the UnicodeData.txt file the ranges are generated from.

source_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of that file, as fetched.

name.description: The identifier of the row, unique in its list: a general category or a group of them, as the clauses name it.

values.description: The general category values of UnicodeData.txt that the row joins.

ranges.description: Code points in hexadecimal: one code point, or two joined by a hyphen, both ends included. Ascending, disjoint, and no two of them adjacent.

clauses.description: The clause ids of the 0.2 documents that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.
